A calm pale cream/sky SINGLE ROW, visually about 60 logical mobile pixels high for a 390px-wide viewport. Remove the large word ALEJO completely from this header. At right, in the SAME ROW, show:
"Contacto" as a small clear dark link
"CV ↓" as a compact outlined control
"Menú ☰" as a compact outlined control with the full readable word Menú.

"Alejo"
"Palavecino"
Retain the pixel display style, dark navy #102E3C, but at a balanced approximately 32-36 logical px, never excessively large. Left-aligned with about 20 logical px side margins.

"Transformo ideas en productos."
Then the quieter specialty line:
"Full stack · Automatización · IA aplicada"

primary coral "Ver proyectos →"
secondary cream outlined "Contactar"

Preserve palette #102E3C ink, #FFF4DF paper, coral #EB654F, blue sky, green/ochre pixel landscape.
No additional Alejo text anywhere. No extra brand. Professional, playful and legible.
